title: The Delivery Charge a Standing Catalogue Order Is Taken to Have Carried
content:
The delivery charge a stopped catalogue order carried is taken from the card's tier, according to the service the standing order was sent by.

The delivery charge the order carried is the expedited delivery charge the card's tier makes, where an order stands on the card that was sent by the expedited service and the card is one that offers catalogue ordering; it is the standard delivery charge the card's tier makes, where an order stands that was sent by the standard service and the card's tier makes a charge for standard delivery; and it is nothing in every other case.

| What the programme's orders show | The delivery charge the order carried |
|---|---|
| a standing order sent by the expedited service, on a card of the Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programmes that offers catalogue ordering | the expedited delivery charge that tier makes |
| a standing order sent by the standard service, on a tier that makes a charge for standard delivery | the standard delivery charge that tier makes |
| a standing order sent by the standard service, on a tier that makes no charge for standard delivery | nothing |
| no standing order at all | nothing |

The service an order was sent by is read from that order's own record; a standing order is one recorded against the programme as placed.

**A point of judgement.** The second row turns on the tier's own charge as well as on the service: where a tier makes no charge for standard delivery, a standing order sent by that service carries a delivery charge of nothing, and the third row is reached rather than the second.
